posts.text:
Eight minutes to get President Trump into the Oval Office, with a storm threatening to derail the Freedom 250 UFC fight at the White House.

Dana White tells @LaraLeaTrump on @MyViewFNC how his head of production made an urgent call as the team scrambled to pull off a critical moment.

Then, White says, the storm suddenly broke apart and moved around the White House, without a single drop of rain hitting the South Lawn or Ellipse all night.

White claims 85,000 people gathered on the Ellipse and calls it “the most amazing event” he’s ever been part of.
